items.text: 在全新的瓦爾命途挑戰聯盟中以全新的經濟環境重新啟程 你所有原本的搶先體驗角色會依然保留在搶先體驗聯盟內 且由於本次平衡大改，官方已提供免費天賦樹重置 我們強烈建議你加入新賽季，以完整體驗 0.4.0 更新所帶來的所有改動
在瓦爾命途挑戰聯盟賽季中，你將發現遍布瓦爾克拉斯各地的古代瓦爾文明遺跡

隨著腐化再度席捲大地，散落於瓦爾克拉斯各處、早已死寂的瓦爾建築們正重新啟動，並開始影響附近的生物 獻祭污染的怪物以啟動這些裝置，並前往阿茲里的遠古神殿——里拉瓦爾 累積足夠能量後，你便能改造神殿、打造你所想要的專屬房間布局 神殿中的每個房間都帶來豐厚獎勵，從大量通貨與裝備，到更加神祕有趣的驚喜 將某些房間與能強化它的房間相鄰配置，可以提升它的等級，帶來全新的挑戰與報酬 完成更多烽塔事件即可取得更多能量，進一步為神殿加入更多房間 探索在瓦爾女王．阿茲里的統治下，整個瓦爾帝國首都最輝煌的奢華神殿 藉由巨獸之力，阿茲里打算以整個文明為代價追求永恆的年輕 你能阻止她嗎？她的皇家建築師與狂熱追隨者將竭力阻撓你，但或許——過去的一切都還能夠改變……"
瓦爾命途挑戰聯盟提供標準、專家與自力模式，它們皆共享相同核心機制與物品，你也可以建立這些模式的私人聯盟版本
新增可遊玩職業：德魯伊
新增德魯伊的兩個昇華天賦：天啟先知與狂徒薩滿
新增 20 個以上的新技能，主要為野獸型態技能
新增 35 個以上的輔助寶石
新增 8 個以上的族裔輔助——這些更強大的輔助僅能在終局內容中取得
在天賦樹上新增超過 250 個全新天賦
新增 10 件以上全新傳奇物品
新增一種新的武器類型：魔符 魔符是一種用於變形攻擊的雙手軍用武器 裝備魔符後，你將化身為一種動物型態，並獲得該型態的基本攻擊技能 你可隨時切換想要變成的動物型態
新增 4 種全新的增幅物品，具備可作用於物品製作的新詞綴
持續對音效、藝術、特效與場景進行整體性的改良
深淵現已加入核心遊戲內容 你將可在劇情中特定的章節區域（從第二章開始）遭遇深淵事件 深淵事件同時已加入終局內容，並新增深淵碑牌及其相關詞綴
已為《深淵的崛起》內容新增專屬輿圖天賦樹
保存良好的脊椎將不再掉落
靈魂之井任務已更新，以符合深淵不再於所有劇情區域出現的情況
我們大幅優化了 CPU 效能 這些更新不僅提升了關鍵運算的速度，也讓遊戲能更充分地利用你的多核心處理器，從而帶來更高的幀數 整體而言，你的效能應至少能提升 25 %，且在 CPU 成為瓶頸時，幀率驟降的情況也會大幅減少 這對負載沉重的遊戲場景尤其有明顯效果 需要注意的是，若你的瓶頸在 GPU，就不會從這些更新中獲得改善 在 GPU 成為瓶頸時，降低渲染解析度或啟用動態解析可提升效能
空手的基礎攻擊速度現在為每秒 1.65 次攻擊（原為 1.4）
影響視為被包圍的判定敵人需求數量詞綴現在無法將需求敵人數量降至 1 以下
盛怒回復現在會暫停失去盛怒，作用近似於其他獲得盛怒的途徑 這意味著你在回復盛怒時將不會失去任何盛怒
盛怒在不超過 10 點的狀況下不再會有影響角色的視覺效果
來自護甲的物理傷害減免再也無法使一次擊中造成 0 傷害 此改動主要用來防止在非常低等級時，玩家的多段擊中技能對具有 Armour 的怪物造成 0 傷害的情況 現在在這些情況下，該次擊中將會造成 1 點傷害
點燃類的光環效果（包含點燃地面）不再施加無限次的點燃 取而代之的是，它們會施加具有標準持續時間的普通 點燃，並且在點燃持續時間後，當光環下一次對該目標施加 易燃時，會重新施加點燃（與點燃被移除後的行為相同）
流順之風現在每一層增加 1 % 行動速度、2 % 技能速度（原為 3 %）、 10 % 值（原為 15 %），且避免 1 % 承受的偏斜擊中傷害
所有昇華職業給予的技能現在會在取得時自動啟用（某些技能原先需要玩家手動啟動它們） 銳眼
風之守衛昇華天賦已被移除
靶心昇華天賦現在需求預告射擊，且現在會施加 10 層暴擊弱點（原為 5）
新增一個新的昇華天賦：幻影銳眼，會給予幻影銳眼主要技能 幻影銳眼：啟動時，發射遠程攻擊投射物時會創造一個使用插槽內遠程攻擊的幻影，持續一段時間後消失 創造幻影後，你在短暫時間內將無法再創造另外一個 追獵者
汙穢傳染昇華天賦已被移除
有效補救昇華天賦已被移除
衝刺突擊昇華天賦現在同時使你衝刺時無法被沉重暈眩
新增了一個新的道路探求者多選項昇華天賦，擁有以下幾個選項：戰士之道－可以從戰士的天賦出發點配置；女術者之道－可以從女術者的天賦出發點配置 每個選擇同時會給予 4 點天賦點
旅者的智慧昇華天賦現在需求道路探求者 旅者的智慧現在使能力值天賦點提供額外選項：
增加 5 % 傷害
增加 5 % 全域防禦
增加 5 % 消耗效率 亞馬遜
元素湧動昇華天賦已重製：
賦予技能：元素波動
現在使你在消耗能量球時觸發元素湧動，獲得 3 閃電波動
澎湃灌注昇華天賦已重製：
現在使你在消耗能量球時觸發元素湧動，獲得 2 冰冷、火焰、與閃電波動 儀式行者
儀式獻祭技能的竊取詞綴持續時間改為在等級 1～20 時為 82～120 秒（原為 15～19.75） 品質現在給予竊取詞綴持續時間 + 20（原為 + 2）
腐化生命力昇華天賦現在同時使你對受鮮血沸騰影響的敵人造成 15 % 更多傷害 戰爭使者
玉石切割者的圖釘昇華天賦（現在更名為碎猛之擊）改為使你施加的完全破甲增加所有來自擊中的承受傷害
玉石薩滿的指引昇華天賦（現在更名為先祖之引）所召喚的先祖戰角召喚物的第二段重擊傷害現在會更穩定的擊中近距離的敵人 泰坦
勢不可擋昇華天賦已被移除
不敗戰士昇華天賦（現在更名為輾壓痛擊）現在同時會使你對沉重暈眩的敵人造成 25 % 更多傷害
新增一個新的昇華天賦劈山碎石，給予每 3 次自身使用、且不會創造裂縫的重擊技能以固定角度造成兩道餘震 需求輾壓痛擊 奇塔弗工匠
所有連接至鐵匠傑作昇華天賦的天賦點現在除了原有的加成以外，會額外給予 + 300 護甲
墊鎧昇華天賦已被移除
鉛襯昇華天賦已被移除
重型綁帶昇華天賦已被移除
在墊鎧昇華天賦原先的位置新增奇塔弗銘刻，賦予你的身體護甲增加 60 % 榮耀回復
在鉛襯昇華天賦原先的位置新增尖刺鎧甲，賦予你的身體護甲增加 100 % 荊棘傷害
在重型綁帶昇華天賦原先的位置新增烏圖拉的貢禮，賦予你的身體護甲增加 30 % 精魂
內裡昇華天賦現在減少 100 % 對你擊中時的暴擊傷害加成（原為 50 %）
秘能抑制昇華天賦（現在更名為火焰隔絕）現在賦予你的身體護甲不受所有傷害型異常狀態影響（原僅限點燃）
熔爐熱力昇華天賦所賦予的擊中時火焰法術技能現在觸發插槽技能時不再消耗魔力 現在同時獲得每等級增加 10 % 傷害，並在寶石等級 20 時達到上限 200 %
千錘百鍊昇華天賦所賦予的鍛鍊武器技能現在不消耗魔力 其強化攻擊所觸發的戰燃現在在所有寶石等級都造成 25 % 更多傷害，且擁有 3 公尺的基礎範圍（原為 2.5 公尺）
活體武器昇華天賦所賦予的幻化武器技能現在減少更改目標的頻率，使其花費更多時間於攻擊行動上 除此之外：
幻化為錘時的重擊技能現在有 6 秒的冷卻時間（原為 10 秒）
幻化為細杖時的橫掃技能現在有 6 秒的冷卻時間（原為 10 秒）
修復了一個幻化為長矛時，會導致其朝向敵人衝刺的技能沒有對衝刺的完整路徑造成傷害的錯誤 獄火師
沸騰軀體昇華天賦不再賦予處於高煉獄之炎狀態時，你和你存在範圍內友方獲得相當於 50 % 傷害的火焰傷害 沸騰軀體現在改為在你處於高煉獄之炎狀態時施放法術會獲得元素統治者 元素統治者在高煉獄之炎狀態下沒有持續時間限制 當煉獄之炎達到最大值時失去元素統治者 血法師
血肉低語昇華天賦現在同時賦予受你詛咒的敵人減少 100 % 生命回復率 風暴編織者
拆射灌注昇華天賦現在賦予：拾取元素灌注時，獲得另一個不同的元素灌注（原為 50 %）
風暴回憶昇華天賦現在同時賦予痕跡可以在 50 % 更遠的距離被拾取
頻繁暴雨昇華天賦現在賦予元素技能的上限 + 2（原為 + 1） 時空幻術師
不可避免昇華天賦的命定苦痛技能已受到以下更新：
現在無視詛咒數量上限
現在使受詛咒目標再度被詛咒時，在詛咒效果結束時承受 50 % 對其造成的擊中傷害（原為在寶石等級 1～20 時為 20～33 %） 古靈軍團
奇術注入昇華天賦現在給予每插入 3 顆藍色輔助寶石，最大冰冷抗性 + 1 %（原為 4）；每插入 3 顆紅色輔助寶石，最大火焰抗性 + 1 %（原為 4）；每插入 3 顆綠色輔助寶石，最大閃電抗性 + 1 %（原為 4）
進階奇術昇華天賦所賦予的奇術活力技能現在使你每五秒會被動地生成能量球（原為八秒） 智勇軍師
火力全開！昇華天賦所賦予的支援火力技能已受到以下更新：指令:死從天降現在冷卻時間為 20 秒（原為 40） 現在會每 0.75 秒發射一波齊射（原為每 2 秒） 現在總共發射 6 波齊射（原為 4） 現在寬度為 14 公尺（原寬度為 7.5 公尺） 攻擊傷害現在為 763 %（原為 1140 %）
戰術陣地昇華天賦已受到以下更新：
火砲砲塔不再賦予增加 40 % 禁錮累積，現在改為賦予增加 20 % 技能速度
攻城炮台不再賦予增加 50 % 對受禁錮敵人的傷害，現在改為賦予對受禁錮敵人造成 25 % 更多傷害
迫擊砲現在賦予相當於 25 % 傷害的額外火焰傷害（原為 15 %）
在陣地光環中加入法術圖騰
法術圖騰賦予增加 50 % 暴擊機率 女巫獵人
女巫殺手昇華天賦現在改為敵人有等同於其最大生命 30 % 的專注上限（原為 40 %） 此改動為一項加強
儀式淨身昇華天賦現在改為給予巫術護盾同時也能夠防禦物理和混沌傷害 施法者（現在更名為祈靈者）
……名為無處的家昇華天賦（現在更名為…並免我於傷痛）現在給予 35 % 更少閃避值（原為 50 %）
……充滿光明昇華天賦（現在更名為魂魄永恆不息）現在額外使主要技能增加 50 % 精魂保留效率
……朝向啟蒙奮鬥昇華天賦（現在更名為…而我將怒號）已受到以下更新：
現在有 12 秒的冷卻時間
當你擊中一名敵人並造成元素異常狀態時，獲得無縛之怒 不再擁有每一種異常狀態每 0.2 秒不超過一次的限制
感電和點燃現在給予 1 無縛之怒（原為 2） 夏烏拉侍僧
靈魂昇華現在給予每一級的最大黑暗 + 10（原為 + 8）
夢醒昇華天賦所賦予的遁入裂痕技能的紅炎現在偷取 15 % 生命（原為 7 %）
夢醒昇華天賦所賦予的遁入裂痕技能的藍炎現在偷取 15 % 魔力（原為 7 %）
夢醒昇華天賦所賦予的遁入裂痕技能的紫炎現在持續時間為 8 秒（原為 5 秒）
夢醒昇華天賦所賦予的遁入裂痕技能的火炎現在會在離玩家較近的區域內生成
力量之選、生命之選、和魔力之選昇華天賦現在同時給予增加 50 % 痕跡效果和痕跡拾取距離
虛空之握昇華天賦所賦予的虛空幻影技能現在在所有寶石等級時冷卻時間皆為 4 秒（原為 6～4）
虛空之握昇華天賦所賦予的虛空幻影技能現在會在寶石等級 1～20 時造成 350～1268 % 攻擊傷害（原為 185～670 %）
虛空之握昇華天賦所賦予的虛空幻影技能現在有 3 個冷卻充能（原為 1）
隨著德魯伊與其他新遊戲機制的加入，我們在天賦樹中加入了輔助這些內容的天賦 樹上新增了許多新的星團，主要集中在德魯伊的區域，並且許多既有的天賦也迎來了更新 若你在布局變動的區域分配了點數，你的天賦樹可能會被強制重置
在德魯伊的天賦樹區域新增了超過 250 個新的天賦
天賦樹上的易燃幅度數值已大幅提升
所有獲得火焰、冰冷、和閃電統治者的來源皆改為獲得元素統治者，使多元素流派可以更好的利用此增益 與統治者相關的被動已相應調整並加以精簡
魔域之掌技術（現已更名為空掌之術）關鍵天賦現在每 75 物品閃避值（原為 25）賦予 1 % 更多速度 空手攻擊的基礎攻速現在為每秒 1.65 攻擊（原為 1.4）
荒野行者關鍵天賦已被從天賦樹中移除，其效果被轉移到了一枚新的族裔輔助寶石
元素之相關鍵天賦現在給予你創造的冰冷灌注痕跡改為火焰、你創造的火焰灌注痕跡改為閃電、你創造的閃電灌注痕跡改為冰冷
緋紅攻擊關鍵天賦現在同時給予你造成的流血有 50 % 更多幅度
天賦樹上原本提供在移動時使用技能會減少移動速度懲罰的天賦，其數值已被下調 天賦樹上新增更多提供此數值的天賦，以部分補回削弱
在天賦樹的僧侶區域新增三組攻擊範圍效果星團
在天賦樹的傭兵區域新增兩組投射物速度星團
在天賦樹的遊俠區域新增一組弓星團，並調整一組投射物星團，兩組都會賦予滿溢機率以射出額外一支箭矢
在女巫與僧侶之間新增名為痕跡吸引的新星團
灌注法術傷害（現在更名為主要灌注）天賦現在使痕跡可從 30 % 更遠距離撿拾（原為 20 %）
來自水井之心傳奇珠寶的宏偉貢禮天賦現在使若你有至少 100 貢禮，痕跡獲取距離增加 80 %（原為 50 %）
天賦樹上提供痕跡拾取範圍的小型天賦，現在使痕跡可從 20 % 更遠的距離被收集（原為 15 %）
昇華執業中提供痕跡拾取範圍的小型天賦，現在使痕跡可從 25 % 更遠的距離被收集（原為為 20 %）
純粹電能天賦現在不再提供每 10 智慧增加 2 % 閃電傷害 其現在改為提供 10 % 更多最大閃電傷害
狂野風暴不再提供更多最大閃電傷害 其現在改為提供：獲得 4 % 傷害的額外閃電傷害、獲得 4 % 傷害的額外冰冷傷害、和 + 10 敏捷

groups.title: Updates to Patch Notes · Updates for 8-12-2025 New Patch Notes: Player Changes

items.text: When Parrying, you now hit all enemies in an area in front of you, in addition to the enemy who instigated the Parry.
Parry now always hits the enemy you parried, regardless of distance.
Sprinting no longer prevents heavy stun buildup decay. Passive Skill Tree Changes
Added some additional Parry-related passive nodes to the tree.
Made changes to some existing Parry-related passive nodes, including additional Parry Debuff Magnitude.
Falcon Dive now grants 1 % Attack Speed per 400 Accuracy Rating, up to 20 %. The node now grants 4 % increased attack speed as well.
Added two clusters with increased ailment chance to the Ranger and Monk sections of the tree. Support Changes
Disabled the Greatwood II support.
Greatwood I is now a Lineage support, Cirel's Cultivation.
Ambrosia I is now a Tier II support (previously Tier III).
Added Ambrosia II as a Tier-III support, which consumes 35 % of your Mana Flask's maximum charges, granting 1 % of damage as extra Lightning damage per charge consumed.

Ambrosia support is now Ambrosia I and consumes 14 % of your Mana Flask's maximum charges, granting 2 % of damage as extra Lightning damage per charge consumed (previously consumed 20 % and granted 3 % per charge consumed).
Magnified Area II support gem no longer causes the supported Skill to deal less damage. Unique Changes
The Dusk Vigil Unique Staff now provides 80～120 % increased Spell Damage (previously 60～80 %). Existing items can be updated Using a Divine Orb.
The Dusk Vigil Unique Staff now provides 30～50 % of damage as extra fire. Existing items will not have this mod.
The Taryn's Shiver Unique Staff now provides 80～120 % increased Spell Damage (previously 80～120 % increased Cold Damage). Existing items will not have this mod.

The Taryn's Shiver Unique Staff now provides Enemies Frozen by you take 100 % increased Damage (previously 50 %) and 30 % increased freeze buildup (previously 100 %). Existing items can be updated Using a Divine Orb.

The Earthbound Unique Staff now provides 80～120 % increased Spell Damage (previously 80～120 % increased Lightning Damage), and also provides 20～40 % increased shock chance. Existing items will not have these mods.
The Searing Touch Unique Staff now provides "Ignites Spread to other Enemies that stay within 1.5 metres for 1 second". Existing items will not have this mod.
Carnage Heart now has "100～200 % Increased Amount of Life Leeched" (previously 100 %). Existing items can be updated using a Divine Orb.
The Anvil now has " + 5～10 % to Maximum Block Chance" (previously 3～5 %). Existing items can be updated using a Divine Orb.
Seeing Stars now drops on the Marching Mace base-type (previously Plated Mace). Existing items will not have this change.
Seeing Stars now has "Adds 1～5 to 66～90 Lightning Damage" (previously 1 to 40～45). Existing items will not have this change.
Seeing Stars now has "Adds 24～31 to 36～46 Cold Damage" (previously 12～16 to 22～25). Existing items will not have this change.
Dream Fragments now has "10～15 % Increased Maximum Mana" (previously 10 %). Existing items can be updated using a Divine Orb.
Treefingers now has " + 15～20 to Strength". Existing items will not have this change.
Ghostmarch now has "15 % Increased Movement Speed". Existing items will not have this change.
Greymake now drops with 4 Augment Sockets. Existing items will not have this change.
Powertread now has "15～20 % Increased Movement Speed" (previously 10～15 %). Existing items can be updated using a Divine Orb.
The Bringer of Rain now drops with 4 Augment Sockets. Existing items will not have this change.
Effigy of Cruelty now has "40～50 % Increased Spell Damage" (previously 60～80 %). Existing items can be updated using a Divine Orb.
The Bringer of Rain now has "This Item Gains Bonuses from Socketed Items as though it was a Body Armour". Existing items will not have this change.
Hyrri's Ire now has "200～250 % Increased Evasion Rating" (previously 100～130 %). Existing items can be updated using a Divine Orb.
Rathpith Globe now has "Non-Channelling Spells Deal 6 % Increased Damage per 100 Maximum Life" (previously 10 %). Existing items can be updated using a Divine Orb.

The Vertex no longer has "Equipment and Skill Gems have 50 % reduced Attribute Requirements". It now either generates with "Equipment has 100 % reduced Attribute Requirements" or "Skill Gems have 100 % reduced Attribute Requirements". It also now has no Attribute Requirements. These changes do not affect existing versions of the item.
Indigon now has "10～15 % Increased Spell Damage for Each 200 Total Mana You Have Spent Recently" (previously 35～50 %). Existing items can be updated using a Divine Orb.
Indigon now has "5～10 % Increased Cost of Skills for Each 200 Total Mana Spent Recently" (previously 35～50 %). Existing items can be updated using a Divine Orb.
The Last Lament unique crossbow now only prevents the final loaded bolt from being consumed if the character actually sacrifices life. Item Changes
Omen of Homogenising Exaltation and the Omen of Homogenising Coronation have been disabled from dropping. Existing items are still functional.
Gothic Quarterstaff now has 12 % critical hit chance (previously 11.5 %).
Sinister Quarterstaff now has 12 % critical hit chance (previously 11.5 %), and now deals 55～91 damage (previously 55～92).
Barrier Quarterstaff, Guardian Quarterstaff and Aegis Quarterstaff now have 12～18 % chance to block (previously 10～15 %). You can update existing items with a divine orb.

Hefty Quarterstaff now has 1.3 attacks per second (previously 1.35), now deals 39～81 damage (previously 39～80), and now has the implicit "20～50 % chance to Daze on Hit". Existing items will not have this implicit.
A new endgame quarterstaff has been added with the same implicit as Hefty Quarterstaff.
Cultist Bow now deals 22～36 physical damage (previously 10～17) and 7～19 chaos damage (previously 19～37). You can use a divine orb if you want a worse implicit.
Adherent Bow now deals 35～59 physical damage (previously 21～34) and 14～32 chaos damage (previously 31～59). You can use a divine orb if you want a worse implicit.
Fanatic Bow now deals 48～80 physical damage (previously 42～70) and 28～64 chaos damage (previously 43～71). You can use a divine orb if you want a worse implicit.

Dualstring Bow now has 1.15 Attacks per second (Previously 1.1), now has the implicit: + 50 % Surpassing chance to fire an additional Arrow (Previously Bow Attacks fire an additional arrow), and now deals 19～35 damage (previously 16～31).
Twin Bow now has 1.15 Attacks per second (Previously 1.1), now has the implicit: + 50 % Surpassing chance to fire an additional Arrow (Previously Bow Attacks fire an additional arrow).

Gemini Bow now has 1.15 Attacks per second (Previously 1.1), now has the implicit: + 50 % Surpassing chance to fire an additional Arrow (Previously Bow Attacks fire an additional arrow). Microtransaction Changes
Added a stash tab affinity for Abyss items. Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug where you couldn't pick up items or interact with objects while mounted on a Rhoa Mount.
Fixed an instance in which you would gain the benefits of Rhoa Mount while you are dismounted.

Fixed a bug where Ambrosia Support and Concoct Support were granting their full benefits when only a portion of their desired flask charge consumption could be fulfilled. Both supports now only consume flask charges if their desired amount can be fully fulfilled. Updated Patch Notes:

Added a new Mountain Splitter Ascendancy Passive Skill which grants Every Third Slam Skill that doesn't create Fissures which you use yourself causes 3 additional Aftershocks ahead and to each side of the initial area. Requires Crushing Impacts.

Queen of the Forest now Increases Movement Speed by 25 %, plus 1 % per 600 Evasion Rating, up to a maximum of 75 %. Other Modifiers to Movement Speed except for Sprinting do not apply (previously did not have the constant 25 %, was and uncapped, was per 800, and Sprinting was not an exception) 800) This change does not affect existing items other than to apply the cap and the constant 25 % increase, but the per Evasion rating value, which value will not be changed on existing items. This value can be updated using a Divine Orb.
Ironhead Spear now deals 9～12 damage (from 7～13).
Steelhead Spear now deals 33～44 damage (from 27～50).
War Spear now deals 16～27 damage (from 14～26).
Flying Spear now deals 46～77 damage (from 41～76).
Forked Spear now has 1.55 Attacks per second (previously 1.6), and now deals 13～38 damage (previously 17～32).
Branched Spear now has 1.55 Attacks per second (previously 1.6), and now deals 23～69 damage (previously 31～58).
Pronged Spear now has 1.55 Attacks per second (previously 1.6), and now deals 30～89 damage (previously 40～75).

Barbed Spear, Jagged Spear and Spiked Spear now have 1.5 attacks per second (previously 1.6), 6 % base critical hit chance (previously 6.5 %) and have gained the implicit "Bleeding you inflict deals damage 10～20 % faster". Existing items will not have this implicit.

Broad Spear now has 1.4 attacks per second (previously 1.5), and now deals 32～48 damage (previously 26～48). It now gained the implicit "25 % increased melee strike range with this weapon". Existing items will not have this.

Grand Spear now has 1.4 attacks per second (previously 1.5), and now deals 56～85 damage (previously 46～85). It now gained the implicit "25 % increased melee strike range with this weapon". Existing items will not have this.

Crossblade Spear now has 1.6 attacks per second (previously 1.55), now deals 25～52 damage (previously 28～51) and now has the Implicit "Prevent + 3～7 % of damage previously deflected hits". Existing items will not have this implicit.
Seaglass Spear now has 1.6 attacks per second (previously 1.5) and now deals 29～53 damage (previously 31～57).
Akoyan Spear now has 1.6 attacks per second (previously 1.5) and now deals 39～72 damage (previously 43～80). Updates for 9～12～2025 New Patch Notes: Support gem changes
Spark granted by the Earthbound Unique Voltaic staff is no longer mistakenly supportable by cooldown supports.
Ancestral Cry is no longer mistakenly supportable by cooldown supports.
Plague Burst is now supportable by cooldown supports.
Ember Fusillade granted by Disk Vigil Unique Ashen Staff is no longer mistakenly supportable by cooldown supports.
Quill Burst is now supportable by cooldown supports.
Armour Explosion is now supportable by cooldown supports.
Volcanic Eruption is now supportable by cooldown supports.
Brambles, from Brambleslam, is now supportable by cooldown supports. Skill gem changes
Iron Ward: Nova radius is now 6m (previously 1.8). Now Stores 160 % -480 % of mitigated Physical Damage (previously 65～145 %). Unique changes

The Lethal Draw now has "Bow Attacks Consume 10 % Of Your Maximum Life Flask Charges if Possible To Deal Added Physical Damage Equal to 5～10 % Of Flask's Life Recovery Amount" (previously 5 % of Flask's Life Recovery Amount). Existing items can be updated using a Divine Orb.

The Hateforge Unique now has "300～400 % increased Armour" (previously 50～80 %), existing items can be updated using a Divine Orb. Now has Gain a random charge on reaching maximum Rage, no more than once every 3～6 seconds (previously 1～3 charges). It now also rolls "Gain 3～6 Rage on Hit", this change does not affect existing versions of the item. Item changes
Rabbit Idol now grants 5 % increased Rarity of Items found (from 8 %).
The Lesser Essence of Haste now adds (8～10) % increased Attack Speed to Bows and Crossbows, this is unchanged on Melee Weapons. Existing Items will not be affected by this change.
The Essence of Haste now adds (11～13) % increased Attack Speed to Bows and Crossbows, this is unchanged on Melee Weapons. Existing Items will not be affected by this change.
The Greater Essence of Haste now adds (14～16) % increased Attack Speed to Bows and Crossbows, this is unchanged on Melee Weapons. Existing Items will not be affected by this change.
The Perfect Essence of Sorcery now cannot be applied to Foci. (Now only Wands and Staves). Endgame changes
The Arbiter of Ash will now phase transition at a lower life threshold and will heal to full during the transition. Monster changes
Adjusted the following monsters (and subsequently their spectre variant):
Frost Wraith: Adjusted Spectre Cost, Reduced Cooldown of some skills.
Lightning Wraith: Adjusted Spectre Cost.
Vile Vulture: Improved Monster AI, Adjusted Spectre Cost.
Faridun Impaler: Improved Monster AI, Adjusted Spectre Cost.
Bramble Hulk: Improved Monster AI, Reduced Cooldown of some skills.
Skeletal Reaper: Improved Monster AI, Rebalanced monster power resulting in a lower Spectre Cost.
Cultist Archer: Improved Monster AI, Reduced Cooldown of some skills.
Blackstrider: Rebalanced monster power resulting in a lower Spectre Cost, Improved Monster AI, Increased the Web Mortar skill damage, Reduced Cooldown of some skills.
Mud Simulacrum: Slam damage is now more consistant, Reduced Cooldown of some skills.
Werewolf Prowler: Slightly increased attack damage.

Brimstone Crab: Reduced Cooldown of some skills.
Mar Acolyte: Improved Monster AI, Reduced Cooldown of some skills.
Quadrilla: Improved Monster AI.
Iron Sharpshooter: Improved Monster AI, Reduced Cooldown of some skills.
Iron Thaumaturgist: Improved Monster AI, Reduced Cooldown of some skills.
Fungal Proliferator: Improved Monster AI, Reduced Cooldown of some skills.
Vaal Guard's which throw Oil and Explosive Grenades now have an 11 second Cooldown on their Oil Grenade (previously 2 seconds). Bug fixes
Fixed an issue where in some cases Explosive Shot would remove Fully Broken Armour from enemies. Updated Patch Notes:

Escape Shot: Now fires 7 Ice Fragment Projectiles (previously 4), fires additional Ice Fragments as it levels up (11 at Level 20) and now deals 60～265 % of Attack Damage (previously 55～172 %). Ice Fragments now have an Explosion radius of 2 metres (previously 1.5 metres). Now has equal Magnitude of Chill inflicted as Freeze Buildup.

Ice-Tipped Arrows: **The Cooldown on Ice Fragments is now 150ms (from 300ms), Now Fires 5 Ice Fragments per Empowered Attack (from 3), and now deals 85～187 % of Attack Damage (previously 64～131 %).**Now has a duration of 20 seconds (previously 8). items.text: 在全新的瓦尔命途挑战联盟中以全新的经济环境重新启程 你所有原本的抢先体验角色会依然保留在抢先体验联盟内 且由於本次平衡大改，官方已提供免费天赋树重置 我们强烈建议你加入新赛季，以完整体验 0.4.0 更新所带来的所有改动
在瓦尔命途挑战联盟赛季中，你将发现遍布瓦尔克拉斯各地的古代瓦尔文明遗迹

随著腐化再度席卷大地，散落於瓦尔克拉斯各处、早已死寂的瓦尔建筑们正重新启动，并开始影响附近的生物 献祭污染的怪物以启动这些装置，并前往阿兹里的远古神殿□□里拉瓦尔 累积足够能量后，你便能改造神殿、打造你所想要的专属房间布局 神殿中的每个房间都带来丰厚奖励，从大量通货与装备，到更加神秘有趣的惊喜 将某些房间与能强化它的房间相邻配置，可以提升它的等级，带来全新的挑战与报酬 完成更多烽塔事件即可取得更多能量，进一步为神殿加入更多房间 探索在瓦尔女王．阿兹里的统治下，整个瓦尔帝国首都最辉煌的奢华神殿 藉由巨兽之力，阿兹里打算以整个文明为代价追求永恒的年轻 你能阻止她吗？她的皇家建筑师与狂热追随者将竭力阻挠你，但或许□□过去的一切都还能够改变……"
瓦尔命途挑战联盟提供标准、专家与自力模式，它们皆共享相同核心机制与物品，你也可以建立这些模式的私人联盟版本
新增可游玩职业：德鲁伊
新增德鲁伊的两个升华天赋：天启先知与狂徒萨满
新增 20 个以上的新技能，主要为野兽型态技能
新增 35 个以上的辅助宝石
新增 8 个以上的族裔辅助□□这些更强大的辅助仅能在终局内容中取得
在天赋树上新增超过 250 个全新天赋
新增 10 件以上全新传奇物品
新增一种新的武器类型：魔符 魔符是一种用於变形攻击的双手军用武器 装备魔符后，你将化身为一种动物型态，并获得该型态的基本攻击技能 你可随时切换想要变成的动物型态
新增 4 种全新的增幅物品，具备可作用於物品制作的新词缀
持续对音效、艺术、特效与场景进行整体性的改良
深渊现已加入核心游戏内容 你将可在剧情中特定的章节区域（从第二章开始）遭遇深渊事件 深渊事件同时已加入终局内容，并新增深渊石板及其相关词缀
已为《深渊的崛起》内容新增专属舆图天赋树
保存良好的脊椎将不再掉落
灵魂之井任务已更新，以符合深渊不再於所有剧情区域出现的情况
我们大幅优化了 CPU 效能 这些更新不仅提升了关键运算的速度，也让游戏能更充分地利用你的多核心处理器，从而带来更高的帧数 整体而言，你的效能应至少能提升 25 %，且在 CPU 成为瓶颈时，帧率骤降的情况也会大幅减少 这对负载沉重的游戏场景尤其有明显效果 需要注意的是，若你的瓶颈在 GPU，就不会从这些更新中获得改善 在 GPU 成为瓶颈时，降低渲染解析度或启用动态解析可提升效能
空手的基础攻击速度现在为每秒 1.65 次攻击（原为 1.4）
影响视为被包围的判定敌人需求数量词缀现在无法将需求敌人数量降至 1 以下
盛怒回复现在会暂停失去盛怒，作用近似於其他获得盛怒的途径 这意味著你在回复盛怒时将不会失去任何盛怒
盛怒在不超过 10 点的状况下不再会有影响角色的视觉效果
来自护甲的物理伤害减免再也无法使一次击中造成 0 伤害 此改动主要用来防止在非常低等级时，玩家的多段击中技能对具有 Armour 的怪物造成 0 伤害的情况 现在在这些情况下，该次击中将会造成 1 点伤害
点燃类的光环效果（包含点燃地面）不再施加无限次的点燃 取而代之的是，它们会施加具有标准持续时间的普通 点燃，并且在点燃持续时间后，当光环下一次对该目标施加 易燃时，会重新施加点燃（与点燃被移除后的行为相同）
流顺之风现在每一层增加 1 % 行动速度、2 % 技能速度（原为 3 %）、 10 % 值（原为 15 %），且避免 1 % 承受的偏斜击中伤害
所有升华职业给予的技能现在会在取得时自动启用（某些技能原先需要玩家手动启动它们） 锐眼
风之守卫升华天赋已被移除
靶心升华天赋现在需求预告射击，且现在会施加 10 层暴击弱点（原为 5）
新增一个新的升华天赋：幻影锐眼，会给予幻影锐眼主要技能 幻影锐眼：启动时，发射远程攻击投射物时会创造一个使用插槽内远程攻击的幻影，持续一段时间后消失 创造幻影后，你在短暂时间内将无法再创造另外一个 追猎者
污秽传染升华天赋已被移除
有效补救升华天赋已被移除
冲刺突击升华天赋现在同时使你冲刺时无法被沉重晕眩
新增了一个新的道路探求者多选项升华天赋，拥有以下几个选项：战士之道－可以从战士的天赋出发点配置；女术者之道－可以从女术者的天赋出发点配置 每个选择同时会给予 4 点天赋点
旅者的智慧升华天赋现在需求道路探求者 旅者的智慧现在使能力值天赋点提供额外选项：
增加 5 % 伤害
增加 5 % 全域防御
增加 5 % 消耗效率 亚马逊
元素涌动升华天赋已重制：
赋予技能：元素波动
现在使你在消耗能量球时触发元素涌动，获得 3 闪电波动
澎湃灌注升华天赋已重制：
现在使你在消耗能量球时触发元素涌动，获得 2 冰冷、火焰、与闪电波动 仪式行者
仪式献祭技能的窃取词缀持续时间改为在等级 1～20 时为 82～120 秒（原为 15～19.75） 品质现在给予窃取词缀持续时间 + 20（原为 + 2）
腐化生命力升华天赋现在同时使你对受鲜血沸腾影响的敌人造成 15 % 更多伤害 战争使者
玉石切割者的图钉升华天赋（现在更名为碎猛之击）改为使你施加的完全破甲增加所有来自击中的承受伤害
玉石萨满的指引升华天赋（现在更名为先祖之引）所召唤的先祖战角召唤物的第二段重击伤害现在会更稳定的击中近距离的敌人 泰坦
势不可挡升华天赋已被移除
不败战士升华天赋（现在更名为辗压痛击）现在同时会使你对沉重晕眩的敌人造成 25 % 更多伤害
新增一个新的升华天赋劈山碎石，给予每 3 次自身使用、且不会创造裂缝的重击技能以固定角度造成两道余震 需求辗压痛击 奇塔弗工匠
所有连接至铁匠杰作升华天赋的天赋点现在除了原有的加成以外，会额外给予 + 300 护甲
垫铠升华天赋已被移除
铅衬升华天赋已被移除
重型绑带升华天赋已被移除
在垫铠升华天赋原先的位置新增奇塔弗铭刻，赋予你的身体护甲增加 60 % 荣耀回复
在铅衬升华天赋原先的位置新增尖刺铠甲，赋予你的身体护甲增加 100 % 荆棘伤害
在重型绑带升华天赋原先的位置新增乌图拉的贡礼，赋予你的身体护甲增加 30 % 精魂
内里升华天赋现在减少 100 % 对你击中时的暴击伤害加成（原为 50 %）
秘能抑制升华天赋（现在更名为火焰隔绝）现在赋予你的身体护甲不受所有伤害型异常状态影响（原仅限点燃）
熔炉热力升华天赋所赋予的击中时火焰法术技能现在触发插槽技能时不再消耗魔力 现在同时获得每等级增加 10 % 伤害，并在宝石等级 20 时达到上限 200 %
千锤百炼升华天赋所赋予的锻炼武器技能现在不消耗魔力 其强化攻击所触发的战燃现在在所有宝石等级都造成 25 % 更多伤害，且拥有 3 公尺的基础范围（原为 2.5 公尺）
活体武器升华天赋所赋予的幻化武器技能现在减少更改目标的频率，使其花费更多时间於攻击行动上 除此之外：
幻化为锤时的重击技能现在有 6 秒的冷却时间（原为 10 秒）
幻化为节杖时的横扫技能现在有 6 秒的冷却时间（原为 10 秒）
修复了一个幻化为战矛时，会导致其朝向敌人冲刺的技能没有对冲刺的完整路径造成伤害的错误 狱火师
沸腾躯体升华天赋不再赋予处於高炼狱之炎状态时，你和你存在范围内友方获得相当於 50 % 伤害的火焰伤害 沸腾躯体现在改为在你处於高炼狱之炎状态时施放法术会获得元素统治者 元素统治者在高炼狱之炎状态下没有持续时间限制 当炼狱之炎达到最大值时失去元素统治者 血法师
血肉低语升华天赋现在同时赋予受你诅咒的敌人减少 100 % 生命回复率 风暴编织者
拆射灌注升华天赋现在赋予：拾取元素灌注时，获得另一个不同的元素灌注（原为 50 %）
风暴回忆升华天赋现在同时赋予痕迹可以在 50 % 更远的距离被拾取
频繁暴雨升华天赋现在赋予元素技能的上限 + 2（原为 + 1） 时空幻术师
不可避免升华天赋的命定苦痛技能已受到以下更新：
现在无视诅咒数量上限
现在使受诅咒目标再度被诅咒时，在诅咒效果结束时承受 50 % 对其造成的击中伤害（原为在宝石等级 1～20 时为 20～33 %） 古灵军团
奇术注入升华天赋现在给予每插入 3 颗蓝色辅助宝石，最大冰冷抗性 + 1 %（原为 4）；每插入 3 颗红色辅助宝石，最大火焰抗性 + 1 %（原为 4）；每插入 3 颗绿色辅助宝石，最大闪电抗性 + 1 %（原为 4）
进阶奇术升华天赋所赋予的奇术活力技能现在使你每五秒会被动地生成能量球（原为八秒） 智勇军师
火力全开！升华天赋所赋予的支援火力技能已受到以下更新：指令:死从天降现在冷却时间为 20 秒（原为 40） 现在会每 0.75 秒发射一波齐射（原为每 2 秒） 现在总共发射 6 波齐射（原为 4） 现在宽度为 14 公尺（原宽度为 7.5 公尺） 攻击伤害现在为 763 %（原为 1140 %）
战术阵地升华天赋已受到以下更新：
火炮炮塔不再赋予增加 40 % 禁锢累积，现在改为赋予增加 20 % 技能速度
攻城炮台不再赋予增加 50 % 对受禁锢敌人的伤害，现在改为赋予对受禁锢敌人造成 25 % 更多伤害
迫击炮现在赋予相当於 25 % 伤害的额外火焰伤害（原为 15 %）
在阵地光环中加入法术图腾
法术图腾赋予增加 50 % 暴击机率 女巫猎人
女巫杀手升华天赋现在改为敌人有等同於其最大生命 30 % 的专注上限（原为 40 %） 此改动为一项加强
仪式净身升华天赋现在改为给予巫术护盾同时也能够防御物理和混沌伤害 施法者（现在更名为祈灵者）
……名为无处的家升华天赋（现在更名为…并免我於伤痛）现在给予 35 % 更少闪避值（原为 50 %）
……充满光明升华天赋（现在更名为魂魄永恒不息）现在额外使主要技能增加 50 % 精魂保留效率
……朝向启蒙奋斗升华天赋（现在更名为…而我将怒号）已受到以下更新：
现在有 12 秒的冷却时间
当你击中一名敌人并造成元素异常状态时，获得无缚之怒 不再拥有每一种异常状态每 0.2 秒不超过一次的限制
感电和点燃现在给予 1 无缚之怒（原为 2） 夏乌拉侍僧
灵魂升华现在给予每一级的最大黑暗 + 10（原为 + 8）
梦醒升华天赋所赋予的遁入裂痕技能的红炎现在偷取 15 % 生命（原为 7 %）
梦醒升华天赋所赋予的遁入裂痕技能的蓝炎现在偷取 15 % 魔力（原为 7 %）
梦醒升华天赋所赋予的遁入裂痕技能的紫炎现在持续时间为 8 秒（原为 5 秒）

在传送点世界地图中，选取地表地图上标示的地下地点时，现在会直接传送至该位置，而非切换至地下地图检视

items.text: When Parrying, you now hit all enemies in an area in front of you, in addition to the enemy who instigated the Parry.
Parry now always hits the enemy you parried, regardless of distance.
Sprinting no longer prevents heavy stun buildup decay. Passive Skill Tree Changes
Added some additional Parry-related passive nodes to the tree.
Made changes to some existing Parry-related passive nodes, including additional Parry Debuff Magnitude.
Falcon Dive now grants 1 % Attack Speed per 400 Accuracy Rating, up to 20 %. The node now grants 4 % increased attack speed as well.
Added two clusters with increased ailment chance to the Ranger and Monk sections of the tree. Support Changes
Disabled the Greatwood II support.
Greatwood I is now a Lineage support, Cirel's Cultivation.
Ambrosia I is now a Tier II support (previously Tier III).
Added Ambrosia II as a Tier-III support, which consumes 35 % of your Mana Flask's maximum charges, granting 1 % of damage as extra Lightning damage per charge consumed.

Ambrosia support is now Ambrosia I and consumes 14 % of your Mana Flask's maximum charges, granting 2 % of damage as extra Lightning damage per charge consumed (previously consumed 20 % and granted 3 % per charge consumed).
Magnified Area II support gem no longer causes the supported Skill to deal less damage. Unique Changes
The Dusk Vigil Unique Staff now provides 80～120 % increased Spell Damage (previously 60～80 %). Existing items can be updated Using a Divine Orb.
The Dusk Vigil Unique Staff now provides 30～50 % of damage as extra fire. Existing items will not have this mod.
The Taryn's Shiver Unique Staff now provides 80～120 % increased Spell Damage (previously 80～120 % increased Cold Damage). Existing items will not have this mod.

The Taryn's Shiver Unique Staff now provides Enemies Frozen by you take 100 % increased Damage (previously 50 %) and 30 % increased freeze buildup (previously 100 %). Existing items can be updated Using a Divine Orb.

The Earthbound Unique Staff now provides 80～120 % increased Spell Damage (previously 80～120 % increased Lightning Damage), and also provides 20～40 % increased shock chance. Existing items will not have these mods.
The Searing Touch Unique Staff now provides "Ignites Spread to other Enemies that stay within 1.5 metres for 1 second". Existing items will not have this mod.
Carnage Heart now has "100～200 % Increased Amount of Life Leeched" (previously 100 %). Existing items can be updated using a Divine Orb.
The Anvil now has " + 5～10 % to Maximum Block Chance" (previously 3～5 %). Existing items can be updated using a Divine Orb.
Seeing Stars now drops on the Marching Mace base-type (previously Plated Mace). Existing items will not have this change.
Seeing Stars now has "Adds 1～5 to 66～90 Lightning Damage" (previously 1 to 40～45). Existing items will not have this change.
Seeing Stars now has "Adds 24～31 to 36～46 Cold Damage" (previously 12～16 to 22～25). Existing items will not have this change.
Dream Fragments now has "10～15 % Increased Maximum Mana" (previously 10 %). Existing items can be updated using a Divine Orb.
Treefingers now has " + 15～20 to Strength". Existing items will not have this change.
Ghostmarch now has "15 % Increased Movement Speed". Existing items will not have this change.
Greymake now drops with 4 Augment Sockets. Existing items will not have this change.
Powertread now has "15～20 % Increased Movement Speed" (previously 10～15 %). Existing items can be updated using a Divine Orb.
The Bringer of Rain now drops with 4 Augment Sockets. Existing items will not have this change.
Effigy of Cruelty now has "40～50 % Increased Spell Damage" (previously 60～80 %). Existing items can be updated using a Divine Orb.
The Bringer of Rain now has "This Item Gains Bonuses from Socketed Items as though it was a Body Armour". Existing items will not have this change.
Hyrri's Ire now has "200～250 % Increased Evasion Rating" (previously 100～130 %). Existing items can be updated using a Divine Orb.
Rathpith Globe now has "Non-Channelling Spells Deal 6 % Increased Damage per 100 Maximum Life" (previously 10 %). Existing items can be updated using a Divine Orb.

The Vertex no longer has "Equipment and Skill Gems have 50 % reduced Attribute Requirements". It now either generates with "Equipment has 100 % reduced Attribute Requirements" or "Skill Gems have 100 % reduced Attribute Requirements". It also now has no Attribute Requirements. These changes do not affect existing versions of the item.
Indigon now has "10～15 % Increased Spell Damage for Each 200 Total Mana You Have Spent Recently" (previously 35～50 %). Existing items can be updated using a Divine Orb.
Indigon now has "5～10 % Increased Cost of Skills for Each 200 Total Mana Spent Recently" (previously 35～50 %). Existing items can be updated using a Divine Orb.
The Last Lament unique crossbow now only prevents the final loaded bolt from being consumed if the character actually sacrifices life. Item Changes
Omen of Homogenising Exaltation and the Omen of Homogenising Coronation have been disabled from dropping. Existing items are still functional.
Gothic Quarterstaff now has 12 % critical hit chance (previously 11.5 %).
Sinister Quarterstaff now has 12 % critical hit chance (previously 11.5 %), and now deals 55～91 damage (previously 55～92).
Barrier Quarterstaff, Guardian Quarterstaff and Aegis Quarterstaff now have 12～18 % chance to block (previously 10～15 %). You can update existing items with a divine orb.

Hefty Quarterstaff now has 1.3 attacks per second (previously 1.35), now deals 39～81 damage (previously 39～80), and now has the implicit "20～50 % chance to Daze on Hit". Existing items will not have this implicit.
A new endgame quarterstaff has been added with the same implicit as Hefty Quarterstaff.
Cultist Bow now deals 22～36 physical damage (previously 10～17) and 7～19 chaos damage (previously 19～37). You can use a divine orb if you want a worse implicit.
Adherent Bow now deals 35～59 physical damage (previously 21～34) and 14～32 chaos damage (previously 31～59). You can use a divine orb if you want a worse implicit.
Fanatic Bow now deals 48～80 physical damage (previously 42～70) and 28～64 chaos damage (previously 43～71). You can use a divine orb if you want a worse implicit.

Dualstring Bow now has 1.15 Attacks per second (Previously 1.1), now has the implicit: + 50 % Surpassing chance to fire an additional Arrow (Previously Bow Attacks fire an additional arrow), and now deals 19～35 damage (previously 16～31).
Twin Bow now has 1.15 Attacks per second (Previously 1.1), now has the implicit: + 50 % Surpassing chance to fire an additional Arrow (Previously Bow Attacks fire an additional arrow).

Gemini Bow now has 1.15 Attacks per second (Previously 1.1), now has the implicit: + 50 % Surpassing chance to fire an additional Arrow (Previously Bow Attacks fire an additional arrow). Microtransaction Changes
Added a stash tab affinity for Abyss items. Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug where you couldn't pick up items or interact with objects while mounted on a Rhoa Mount.

sections.title: The Fate of the Vaal League

items.text: Start fresh in a new economy with The Fate of the Vaal league. All of your old characters from Early Access are still present in the Early Access leagues but a free passive tree refund has been granted due to the changes. We would highly encourage you to join the new leagues to fully take in the changes we've made with the 0.4.0 update.
In the Fate of the Vaal league you will find remnants of the ancient Vaal civilisation scattered throughout Wraeclast.

Now that corruption has returned to the land, the long-dead Vaal structures throughout Wraeclast are activating and affecting nearby creatures. Sacrifice the afflicted monsters to power the devices, and travel to Lira Vaal, the ancient temple of Atziri. Gather enough power to modify the Temple and create your desired layout. Each room in the Temple offers great rewards, from stashes of currency and equipment to something more interesting. Placing rooms next to other rooms that benefit them will level them up, adding new challenges and rewards to find. Complete more beacons to get more energy to fuel more additions to the temple. Explore the Queen of the Vaal's opulent temple during the height of her power in the capital of the ancient empire. With the power of the Beast, Atziri plans to risk her entire civilization in pursuit of eternal youth. Can she be stopped? Her Royal Architect and devoted followers will work against you, but perhaps the past is not set in stone…

There are Standard, Hardcore and Solo Self-Found variations of The Fate of the Vaal League available. They have the same core mechanics and items, and you can create private league versions of these leagues.
Added a new playable character class, the Druid.
Added the new Oracle and Shaman Ascendancy Classes for the Druid.
Added over 20 new Skills, primarily Primal Skills.
Added over 35 new Supports.
Also introduced over 8 new Lineage Supports, much more powerful Supports that are only available in Endgame.
Added over 250 new passive skills to the passive tree.
Added over 10 new Unique Items.

Added a new weapon class: Talismans. Talismans are two-handed martial weapons that are used for shapeshifting attacks. Equipping a talisman shapeshifts you into an animal form and grants you a basic attack skill for that form. You can swap your chosen form at any time.
Added 4 new Augment items with new modifiers that you can craft onto your items.
Continued to incrementally improve the sound, art, effects and environments.

Abyss has been added to the core game. You can find Abyss encounters in specific campaign areas, starting in Act 2. Abyss encounters have been added to the Endgame, as well as Abyss Tablets and related modifiers.
Added an Atlas Passive Tree for the Rise of the Abyssal Content.
Preserved Vertebrae no longer drop.
Updated The Well of Souls quest to account for the fact that Abysses no longer spawn in all campaign areas.

Significant optimizations to CPU performance have been made. These changes both improve the speed of key operations, and allow us to utilise more of your CPU cores, resulting in higher frame rates. Overall, you should get at least a 25 % boost, and significantly less frame spikes when CPU bound. This is especially impactful for heavy gameplay situations. Note that if you are GPU bound, you will not see any improvement from these changes. When GPU bound, lowering render resolution or using Dynamic Resolution will improve performance.
Tailwind now grants 1 % increased movement speed, 2 % increased Skill Speed (previously 3 %), 10 % increased Evasion Rating (previously 15 %) and prevent 1 % of Damage from Deflected Hits per stack.
Base unarmed attack time is now 1.65 attacks per second (previously 1.4).
Modifiers to the number of enemies required to be considered Surrounded can no longer reduce the required number of enemies below 1.
Rage regeneration now pauses rage decay similarly to other means of gaining rage. This means that your rage will never decay while it is regenerating.
All rage spending costs have been changed to 10 rage. Rage no longer causes a visual effect on your character until you have 10 or more Rage so that you know that you can use these abilities.
You now lose 5 rage per second if you have not taken damage or gained rage in the past 4 seconds (from 10 rage per second if not taken damage or gained rage in the past 2 seconds).

Physical Damage Reduction from Armour can no longer cause a hit to deal 0 damage. This is mostly targeted at preventing cases where multi-hitting player skills could deal 0 damage to armoured monsters at very low levels. In these cases, the hit will now deal 1 damage.

Igniting aura effects, including Ignited Ground, no longer apply infinite ignites. Instead they apply regular ignites with standard duration, and will reapply them after they expire the next time the aura applies flammability to that target (the same as if Ignite had been removed from the target).
When Parrying, you now hit all enemies in an area in front of you, in addition to the enemy who instigated the Parry.
Parry now always hits the enemy you parried, regardless of distance.
Sprinting no longer prevents heavy stun buildup decay.
Totem Placement speed now also scales the speed at which Totems emerge.
All Skills granted by an Ascendency are now automatically activated when granted (some previously required the player to manually activate them).
Wind Ward has been Removed.
Bullseye now requires Called Shots. Bullseye now applies 10 Critical Weakness (previously 5).

Added a new Mirage Deadeye Ascendancy Passive Skill which grants the Mirage Deadeye Meta Skill. Mirage Deadeye: While active, firing a Ranged Attack Projectile will create a Mirage that uses socketed Ranged Attacks for a short duration, then vanishes. You cannot create another Mirage for a short time after initially creating one.
Contagious Contamination has been Removed.
Practical Remedies has been Removed.
Running Assault now also grants Cannot be Heavy Stunned while Sprinting.

Added a new Path Seeker multi-choice Ascendancy Passive Skill with the following choices: Path of the Warrior - Can Allocate Passives from the Warrior's starting point, Path of the Sorceress - Can Allocate Passives from the Sorceress's starting point. Each choice also Grants 4 Passive Skill Points.
Traveller's Wisdom now requires Path Seeker. Traveller's Wisdom now instead grants Attribute Passive Skills offer additional Options:
5 % increased Damage
5 % increased Global Defences
5 % increased Cost Efficiency
Elemental Surge reworked:
Grants Skill: Elemental Surge
Now provides When you consume a Charge Trigger Elemental Surge to gain 3 Lightning Surges.
Surging Avatar reworked:
Now provides When you consume a Charge, Trigger Elemental Surge to instead gain 2 Cold, Lightning and Fire Surges.
Ritual Sacrifice Stolen Modifier duration is 82～120 seconds from Gem level 1～20 (previously 15～19.75). Quality is now + 20 seconds to Stolen Modifier duration (previously + 2).
Corrupted Lifeforce now also has You deal 15 % more Damage to Enemies Affected by Blood Boil.
Imploding Impacts now also grants Fully Broken Armour you inflict increases all Damage Taken from Hits instead.
The Ancestral Warhorn minion summoned by Warbringer's Answered Call notable now more consistently hits close-up enemies with the second part of its slam attack.
Surprising Strength has been removed.
Crushing Impacts now also Grants 25 % more Damage against Heavy Stunned Enemies.

Added a new Mountain Splitter Ascendancy Passive Skill which grants Every Third Slam Skill that doesn't create Fissures which you use yourself causes 3 additional Aftershocks ahead and to each side of the initial area. Requires Crushing Impacts.
Each Notable connected to the Smith's Masterwork Notable now grants + 200 to Armour in addition to its other bonuses.
Padded Plates has been removed.
Lead Lining has been removed.
Heavy Bracing has been removed.
Added Kitavan Imprint in place of Padded Plates, which causes your Body Armour to grant 60 % increased Glory Generation.
Added Spiked Plates in place of Lead Lining, which causes your Body Armour to grant 100 % increased Thorns Damage.
Added Tribute to Utula in place of Heavy Bracing, which causes your Body Armour to grant 30 % increased Spirit.
Internal Layer now reduces Critical Damage taken by 100 % (previously 50 %).
Heatproofing now causes your Body Armour to grant the bonus of being Unaffected by all Damaging Ailments (previously just ignite).

The Fire Spell on Melee Hit Skill granted by Heat of the Forge on Smith of Kitava now costs no mana when triggering Socketed Spells. It also now gains 10 % increased Damage per Level, up to 200 % increased Damage at gem level 20.

The Temper Weapon Skill granted by Against the Anvil on Smith of Kitava now costs no mana. The Combust triggered by it's Empowered Attacks now deal 25 % more Damage at all Levels and has a base radius of 3 Metres (previously 2.5 metres).
The Manifest Weapon Skill granted by Living Weapon on Smith of Kitava now changes target less frequently, and thus spends more time actively attacking. Additionally:
As a Mace, now has a cooldown of 6 seconds (from 10 seconds) for its Slam Skill.
As a Quarterstaff, now has a cooldown of 6 seconds (from 10 seconds) on its Sweep Skill.
As a Spear, fixed a bug where the damage dealt while it was Dashing towards enemies didn't cover the full distance of the Dash.

Seething Body no longer grants While on High Infernal Flame, you and Allies in your Presence Gain 50 % of Damage as Fire Damage. Seething Body now grants Gain Elemental Archon when you cast a Spell while on High Infernal Flame. Elemental Archon does not expire while on High Infernal Flame. Lose Elemental Archon on reaching maximum Infernal Flame.
Whispers of the Flesh now also grants Targets Cursed by you have 100 % reduced Life Regeneration Rate.
Refracted Infusion now grants: When collecting an Elemental Infusion, gain another different Elemental Infusion (previously 50 % chance).
Storms Recollection now also grants Remnants can be collected from 50 % further away.
Multiplying Squalls now grants + 2 to Limit of Elemental Skills (previously 1).
Inevitable Agony granted by Inevitability has been updated:
Now ignores the Curse Limit.
Now causes Cursed Targets to take 50 % of Hit Damage dealt to them while Cursed again when Curse expires (previously 20 % at Gem level 1, scaling to 33 % by Gem level 20).

Thaumaturgical Infusion now grants: + 1 % to Maximum Cold Resistance per 3 Blue Support Gems Socketed (previously 4). + 1 % to Maximum Fire Resistance per 3 Red Support Gems Socketed (previously 4). + 1 % to Maximum Lightning Resistance per 3 Green Support Gems Socketed (previously 4).
Thaumaturgical Dynamism granted by Advanced Thaumaturgy Notable Passive Skill now generates a Charge once every five seconds (previously once every eight seconds).

The Supporting Fire Skill granted by Unleash Hell! Notable Passive Skill has been updated: Command: Death From Above Cooldown is now 20 seconds (previously 40). Now fires a Volley every 0.75 seconds (previously every 2 seconds). Now fires 6 total Volleys (previously 4). Now has 14 metre width (previously 7.5 metre width). Attack Damage is now 763 % (previously 1140 %).
Strategic Embankments Notable Passive Skill has been updated:
Artillery Ballista no longer grants 40 % increased Immobilisation Buildup, now grants 20 % increased Skill Speed.
Siege Ballista no longer grants 50 % increased Damage against Immobilised Enemies, now grants 25 % more Damage against Immobilised Enemies.
Mortar Cannon now grants 25 % of Damage Gained as extra Fire, from 15 %.
Added Spell Totem to Embankment Auras.
Spell Totem grants 50 % increased Critical Hit Chance.
Witchbane now has Enemies have Maximum Concentration equal to 30 % of their Maximum Life (previously 40 %). This is a buff.
Ceremonial Ablution now instead grants Sorcery Ward also protects against Physical and Chaos Damage.
...and Protect me from harm: Now grants 35 % less Evasion Rating (previously 50 % less).
The Soul Springs Eternal now additionally grants Meta Skills have 50 % increased Spirit Reservation Efficiency.
Unbound Avatar Skill granted by...and I Shall Rage has been updated:
Now has a cooldown of 12 seconds.
Gain Unbound Fury when you inflict an Elemental Ailment with a Hit on an Enemy, no longer has 'No more than once every 0.2 seconds for each type of Ailment'.
Shocking and Igniting now grant 1 Unbound Fury (previously 2).
Embrace the Darkness now gives + 10 to maximum Darkness per Level (previously + 8).
The Into the Breach Skill granted by Waking Dream' Red Flames now Leech 15 % Life (previously 7 %).
The Into the Breach Skill granted by Waking Dream' Blue Flames now Leech 15 % Mana (previously 7 %).
The Into the Breach Skill granted by Waking Dream' Purple Flames now last 8 seconds (previously 5 seconds).
The Into the Breach Skill granted by Waking Dream' Flames are now created closer to the Player.
Choice of Power, Choice of Life and Choice of Mana now all also grant 50 % increased effect of Remnants, and 50 % increased Remnant Pickup Range.
The Void Illusion Skill granted by Grasp of the Void now has a Cooldown of 4 seconds at all gem levels (previously 6～4).
The Void Illusion Skill granted by Grasp of the Void now deals 350～1268 % Attack Damage at Gem levels 1～20 (previously 185～670 %).
The Void Illusion Skill granted by Grasp of the Void now has 3 Cooldown Charges (previously 1).

With the addition of the Druid and other new game mechanics we've added passive support for these throughout the Passive Skill Tree. There are many new clusters, mostly in the Druid area of the tree, and many existing Passive Skills have been updated. These changes may result in your existing passive tree being forcefully refunded if you had allocated nodes around the areas where the layout changed.
Added more than 250 new Passive Skills to the Druid side of the passive tree.
The values of Flammability Magnitude on the Passive Tree have been increased massively.

All instances of gaining Flame, Ice and Lightning Archon have been changed to gain Elemental Archon, to better support builds using multiple Elements. Archon related passives on the tree have been adjusted accordingly and condensed.

The Hollow Palm Technique Keystone now Grants 1 % more Attack Speed per 75 Item Evasion Rating on Equipped Armour Items (previously 25). Base unarmed attack time is now 1.65 attacks per second (previously 1.4).
The Walker of the Wilds Keystone has been removed from the passive tree and its effects have been moved onto a newly added Lineage Support.

The Elemental Equilibrium Keystone now grants Cold Infusion Remnants you create are instead Fire, Fire Infusion Remnants you create are instead Lightning, Lightning Infusion Remnants you create are instead Cold.
The Crimson Assault Keystone Passive Skill now also grants 50 % more Magnitude of Bleeding you inflict.

Passives that granted reduced Movement Speed Penalty from using Skills while moving on the Passive Tree have had their values lowered. More passives on the tree now grant the stat to make up for some of this.
Added 3 new Attack Area of Effect Clusters to the Monk part of the Passive Tree.
Added two projectile speed clusters to the Passive Tree in the Mercenary section.
Added a new bow cluster and modified a projectile cluster in the ranger section of the tree, granting Surpassing chance to fire an additional Arrow.
Added a new cluster between Witch and Monk called Remnant Attraction.
Principal Infusion now has Remnants can be collected from 30 % further away (previously 20 %).
The Grand Tribute notable from the Heart of the Well Unique Jewel now has Remnants can be collected from 80 % further away if you have at least 100 Tribute (previously 50 %).
Small nodes on the passive tree that grant Remnant Pickup Range now grant Remnants can be collected from 20 % further away (previously 15 %).
Small nodes on Ascendancies that grant Remnant Pickup Range now grant Remnants can be collected from 25 % further away (previously 20 %).
The small passive connected to the Invigorating Grandeur and Everlasting Glory notables now grants 20 % increased Presence Area of Effect instead of Skills a chance to not consume Glory.
The Pure Power notable no longer grants 2 % increased Lightning Damage per 10 Intelligence. Instead it now grants 10 % more Maximum Lightning Damage.
Wild Storm no longer grants 15 % more Maximum Lightning Damage. It instead now grants: Gain 4 % of Damage as Extra Lightning Damage, Gain 4 % of Damage as Extra Cold Damage and + 10 to Dexterity.
Renamed Tandem Assault passive tree node to Hunting Companion, with no change to functionality.

Changed the stats on several small passive tree nodes around the Inspiring Ally, Hunting Companion, Sic 'Em, and Nourishing Ally nodes. Companion cluster small passive skills now generally no longer grant both Companions deal increased Damage and increased Damage while your Companion is in your Presence.
Added some additional Parry-related passive nodes to the tree.
Made changes to some existing Parry-related passive nodes, including additional Parry Debuff Magnitude.
Falcon Dive now grants 1 % Attack Speed per 400 Accuracy Rating, up to 20 %. The node now grants 4 % increased attack speed as well.
Added two clusters with increased ailment chance to the Ranger and Monk sections of the tree.

Curse Area passive skills on the Passive Tree have been halved, now granting 10 % Curse Area of Effect (previously 20 %). The Zone of Control Notable skill now grants 20 % increased Curse Area of Effect (previously 40 %) but also grants 10 % increased Curse Magnitudes (previously 8 %). The Curse Area small passives on the Lich and Abyssal Lich now grant 15 % increased Curse Area (previously 25 %).
Crescendo I, II, and III are now Intelligence Support gems (previously Dexterity).
Perpetual Charge is now an Intelligence Support gem (previously Dexterity).
Mark for Death is now a Strength Support gem (previously Dexterity).
Gambleshot is now an Intelligence Support gem (previously Dexterity).
Brambleslam is now a Strength Support gem (previously Dexterity).
Disabled the Font of Rage Support Gem.
Disabled the Ricochet III Support Gem.
Disabled the Greatwood II support.
Greatwood I is now a Lineage support, Cirel's Cultivation.
Ambrosia I is now a Tier II support (previously Tier III).
Added Ambrosia II as a Tier-III support, which consumes 35 % of your Mana Flask's maximum charges, granting 1 % of damage as extra Lightning damage per charge consumed.

Ambrosia support is now Ambrosia I and consumes 14 % of your Mana Flask's maximum charges, granting 2 % of damage as extra Lightning damage per charge consumed (previously consumed 20 % and granted 3 % per charge consumed).
Magnified Area II support gem no longer causes the supported Skill to deal less damage.
The Inevitable Critical Support has been renamed to Inexorable Critical I Support.
Added the missing Chaos tag to extraction support.
Second Wind I can no longer support Meta skills.
Second Wind II can no longer support Meta skills.
Second Wind III now has Restore 1 % of maximum Life on use per one second cooldown of Supported Skills (previously 2 %). Can no longer support Meta skills.
World-Drop Lineage Supports are now less common overall. Specific Lineage supports have been adjusted relative to others.
Atalui's Bloodletting Lineage Support now grants 2 % extra Physical damage per 20 Life cost (previously per 10 life cost), up to 40 %, and no longer has a cost multiplier.
Xoph's Pyre now grants Supported Skills gain 40 % of Fire Damage as Extra Chaos Damage (previously 20 %).
Esh's Radiance now grants Supported Skills gain 40 % of Lightning Damage as Extra Chaos Damage (previously 20 %).
Tul's Stillness now grants Supported Skills gain 40 % of Cold Damage as Extra Chaos Damage (previously 20 %).
Uul-Netol's Embrace now grants Supported Skills gain 40 % of Physical Damage as Extra Chaos Damage (previously 20 %).
Einhar's Beastrite now grants Killing Blows from Supported Strike Skills Against Rare Monsters grant two of their Modifiers for 5 Minutes (previously 40 seconds).
Zarokh's Refrain now grants Supported Spells Echo 3 Times (previously 2) and now grants Echoes From Supported Spells have 40 % Increased Area of Effect.
Uruk's Smelting now grants Fully Breaking Armour with Supported Skills causes affected targets to Permanently take 5 % increased Physical Damage, up to 20 % (previously 2 % up to 20 %).
Vilenta's Propulsion now grants 75 % of Increases and Reductions To Cast Speed Also Apply to Projectile Speed for Supported Skills (previously 50 %).
Ahn's Citadel now no longer has Supported Skills have 30 % less Area of Effect or Supported Skills Deal 30 % less damage with hits.

Tecrod's Revenge now Grants Minions from Supported Skills Die 20 seconds after their Life is reduced To 0 (previously 10 seconds) and Minions from Supported Skills Gain 40 % Increased Attack and Cast Speed when their Life is reduced to 0 (previously 20 %).
Rigwald's Ferocity now has Supported Skills have 30 % increased Attack Speed if used in Weapon Set I (previously 20 % more Attack Speed).

Ratha's Assault now Grants Supported Skills Load 5 Bolts When You Dodge (Previously 3) And Supported Skills Load 4 Additional Bolts (previously 3). Ratha's Assault now has Supported Skills have 20 % Increased Attack Speed.
Arjun's Medal now Grants a 100 % Chance To Load A Bolt Into All Crossbow Skills On Dealing A Killing Blow With Supported Skill (previously 35 %).
Kaom's Madness now Grants Supported Skills Deal 20 % less damage (previously 40 %).

Tawhoa's Tending now grants Totems created by Supported Skills have 25 % More Life (previously 50 %) and now Tawhoa's Vengeance's Explosion deals base Physical Damage equal to 20 % of Totem's Maximum Life (previously 10 %).
Atziri's Allure now has Supported Skills have 20 % Less Curse Effect (previously 25 %).

Garukhan's Resolve now Grants Maximum Critical Hit Chance with Supported Skills is 50 %, Also no longer Grants Supported Skills becomes usable after you have moved 20 Metres - Supported Skills become unusable again after use.

Kurgal's Leash now Grants Gain Unholy Might for 15 Seconds on Commanding Minions from Supported Skills (previously 5 seconds) And now also grants Minions from Supported Skills gain Unholy Might for 15 Seconds when Commanded (previously 5 seconds).
Arakaali's Lust now Grants Supported Skills deal 8 % More Damage With Hits for each Poison on the Enemy, up to 40 % (previously 6 % more up to 30 %).
Tacati's Ire now has Poisons from Supported Skills deal damage 2 % Faster Per Rage (previously 1 %).
Ailith's Chimes now grants 25 % Chance to Gain a Power Charge when expending Combo with Supported Skills Per Combo Expended This Chance Can Exceed 100 % (previously 10 % Chance).
Arbiter's Ignition now has 100 % chance to gain Elemental Archon on Igniting an Enemy with Supported Skills (previously 20 % chance to gain Flame Archon).
Nova Projectiles no longer causes Supported skills to gain 4 Additional Projectiles or Supported Skills now deal 40 % less Damage.
Added Nova Projectiles II, causing Supported skills to gain 6 Additional Projectiles, deal 50 % less Damage and applying a Cooldown Time of 8 seconds to Supported Skills.
Piety's Mercy renamed to Dominus' Grasp.
Dominus' Grasp now instead grants Supported Skills Chain 100 % more times.
Chain I Support no longer grants Supported Skills Chain 100 % more times. Now grants Supported Skills deal 30 % less Damage with Hits (previously 50 %).

Chain II Support no longer grants Supported Skills Chain 100 % more times. Now grants Supported Skills Chain + 2 Times (previously + 1). Now grants Supported Skills deal 50 % less Damage with Hits (previously 40 %).
Chain III Support no longer grants Supported Skills Chain 200 % more times. Now grants Supported Skills Chain + 2 Times.

"of the Appeal" now grants "Favours Deferred at Ritual Altars in Map reappear 25 to 40 % sooner" (previously 15 to 40 %).
"of the Foundling" now grants "Revived Monsters from Ritual Altars in Map have 35 to 70 % increased chance to be Magic" (previously 25 to 70 %).
"of the Cult" now grants "Revived Monsters from Ritual Altars in Map have 25 to 40 % increased chance to be Rare" (previously 15 to 40 %).
"of Omens" now grants "Ritual Favours in Map have 35 to 70 % increased chance to be Omens" (previously 25 to 70 %).

"of the Horde" now grants "Abysses in Map spawn 20 to 30 % increased Monsters" (previously 15 to 30 %).
The "of Fleeting" map modifier can now only roll on Tier 11 + Waystones and has a value of 10～15 % (previously 21～25 %).

The Xesht's Madness Breach Atlas Notable no longer provides "Rare Breach Monsters in your Maps have the Soul Eater Modifier", instead provides Rare Breach Monsters have Onslaught and Rare Breach Monsters have 50 % increased Effectiveness.
The Prayer for Wealth Atlas Passive has been removed, due to Greed Shrines no longer being available.
The High Road no longer provides "Waystones found have 20 % chance to be a tier higher", now provides "10 % chance for Waystones found in your Maps to be Rare and Corrupted".
The Get out of my head! and The mirrors... the mirrors! Delirium Atlas Notables have swapped places.

The Get out of my head! Delirium Atlas Notable has been reworked, it now provides Magic Monsters in your Maps have + 25 % chance to have an additional Delirium Modifier and 100 % increased Rarity of Items dropped by Magic Monsters in Maps with multiple Delirium Modifiers.

The Isn't it tempting? Delirium Atlas Notable has been reworked, it now provides Currency which drops from Delirium Monsters in your Maps is stolen by the Map Boss, Each stolen Currency has a + 20 % chance to be Duplicated upon defeating the Map Boss if under the affects of Delirium.

The It's not real, it's not real! Delirium Atlas Notable has been reworked, it now provides Rare Monsters always Manifest Delirium Demons in your Maps, 10 % increased Quantity of Items dropped by Rare Monsters with Manifested Delirium Demons in your Maps and Rare Monsters with Manifested Delirium Demons in your Maps grant 30 % increased Experience.
Waystones can no longer be instilled using Liquid Emotions.
Improved the visuals of Delirium fog and added a radius around the player that improves clarity further, this radius has less of a desaturation effect and makes the fog thinner.
Delirium no longer has the reward bar indicator, instead Delirium monsters have a chance to drop Liquid Emotions.
Delirium Bosses have a guaranteed Liquid Emotion drop and an increased chance to drop higher tier Liquid Emotions.
Boss Waves in the Simulacrum also drop a guaranteed Liquid Emotion with a chance of being a higher tier Liquid Emotion.
Idols of Estazunti are no longer required to unlock Vaal Vault maps. Existing items will be deleted.
The Vaults of Kamasa Unique Map chests are no longer affected by party bonuses.
Removed camera zoom out on completion of tower maps.
Added an objective icon for activating all checkpoints. When a player activates all checkpoints and completes the map, all map content minimap icons will be revealed.

Removed Breach, Ritual, Delirium, and Expedition from the Map Legend as they no longer have icons shown on your Atlas (and instead can be found randomly in maps or added through the use of Precursor Tablets).

Bosses now have an Anti-Burst damage mechanic: Once a boss has finished it's emerge or becomes aggro the damage reduction period starts counting down. The damage reduction tapers down from full effect to no effect over the course of this duration. For every unit the boss moves from it's starting location the damage reduction will fall off even faster. Bosses which cannot or barely move have a shorter damage reduction period.
Improved the visibility of the explosive fungus encountered in The Grim Tangle
Improved the visibility of the explosive fungus spawned by the Fungal Proliferator monster type
Improved the mid fight phase change sequence of the final Act 2 boss
Improved the first phase change sequence of the final Act 4 boss
Improved the behaviour of the Great White One boss.
Made various improvements to Rogue Exile behaviour.
Re-enabled the following Rogue Exiles; Taua, the Ruthless, Ulfred, the Afflicted, Drusian, the Artillerist and Doran, the Deft.
The Blind Beast in Isle of Kin now drops a Blank Greater Rune. This can be exchanged with Dannig in Kingsmarch for a Greater Rune of your choosing (from a selection).

The Blind Beast no longer drops a Bile-soaked Tome. Instead, the Dark Mists quest now grants a Mist-shrouded Tome (which grants two Weapon Set Passive Skill Points) in addition to its existing rewards (Uncut Skill Gem and Gold).
You can now open a Town Portal in Olroth's arena after he has been defeated.
Kosis's Lighting Barrage skill should no longer hit with 9 projectiles at point blank range.

Vaal Guard's which throw Oil and Explosive Grenades now have an 11 second Cooldown on their Oil Grenade (previously 2 seconds).
Support gem compatibility of all equipped skills is now shown when hovering a support gem in the gemcutting interface.
On the waypoint world map, selecting underground locations featured on the overworld map will now immediately teleport you to the selected location, instead of toggling to the underground map view.
Added a 'quick search' feature to the Stat Filters in the Trade Market.
Stackable items will no longer be merged into existing item stacks when ctrl-clicking items into Merchant's Tabs.
Optimised item search for the in-game market browser.
Your current Rage is no longer displayed in your buff bar. Instead, there is now a Rage meter next to the mana globe.
The Cursor Size option has been changed to a slider.

Added a new Cursor Tracking input option for keyboard and mouse users, which allows skills to continue updating their target location/direction even after the skill's input key is released. This is particularly impactful for skills such as Rolling Slam and Whirling Assault, but affects a wide variety of skills. By default this option is enabled in WASD mode and disabled in click to move mode.
When switching between controller and keyboard in the character selection screen, the game will remember if you used WASD or not.
Refactored Couch Coop player interfaces:
Some interfaces that could not be panelled now allow dual cursors so both players can interact with a UI at the same time.
Most player interfaces will now be panelled to minimise disruptions and to improve the gameplay flow in towns. Both players can have different panelled interfaces open at the same time.
The Wardrobe hideout decoration now visually indicates, and opens to your Wishlist page, when a Microtransaction you've previously wishlisted is on sale.

Fixed a bug where effects that spread an Ignite were incorrectly just inflicting a single hit's worth of Flammability when it tried to spread, and only Igniting if flammability was high enough at that time.
Fixed an issue where Lightning Warp could remove corpses of reviving monsters.
Fixed a bug where Wind Dancer's nova did not scale with modifiers to area damage.
Fixed a bug where Ravenous Swarm did not display correct Active Swarm Limit.
Fixed a bug where Electrocuting Arrow was unable to hit enemies that were too short.
Fixed a bug where multiple copies of Thornskin or Thornskin II could be active at the same time.
Fixed an issue that caused Blood Hunt's Blood Loss consumption explosion to sometimes deal the incorrect amount of damage.
Fixed an issue where the visuals for Ice Nova weren't always matching the area in which it hit.
Fixed a bug where the Smith of Kitava's manifest spear would only do damage on the first half of it's dash if the target was far away.
Fixed Glory not generating while on a Rhoa Mount.
Fixed bug where Glory generated from Rare or Unique monsters in your presence generated glory based on your current weapon set's passives instead of each weapon set's passives.
Fixed a bug where Charged Staff did not have a Lightning tag.
Fixed an issue preventing Living Lightning Support from being able to be Supported by certain gems.
Fixed a bug where Perfection was only granting more hit damage rather than all damage.
Fixed an issue that would cause Dark Effigy to have a longer-than-intended delay before firing its first projectile after being raised if there were only one valid target.
Fixed a bug where Battershout Support wasn't working with Fortifying Cry nor Ancestral Cry.
Fixed a bug where exposure applied by oil ground bypassed some defensive mechanics.
Fixed a bug where Second Wind III Support wasn't working with Demon Form. The life restoration now occurs when Demon Form is put on cooldown.
Fixed a bug where Inhibitor Support was granting more damage per Infusion rather than per Infusion type.
Fixed a bug where Unleash could not support Unearth.
Fixed a bug that occurred with Heatshiver and some similar modifiers in cases where an enemy can be affected by multiple chills at the same time.
Fixed a bug where Blasphemy did not display its icon while you have Show Aura Icons checked in the options menu.
Fixed Ancestrally boosted slam effects not showing up when MTX are applied.

Fixed an issue where the Controlled Metamorphosis Unique jewel could have its mod ranges roll beyond the values used to determine the radius. This will not fix jewels where this is already broken, but will prevent this from happening with any new rolls of the item.
Fixed an issue where quest Soul Cores were not removed from the player when used in an Ultimatum encounter.
Fixed a bug where gaining charges over time for Life Flasks or Mana Flasks would not fill both flasks when using the Waistgate Unique Belt with two Life Flasks or Mana Flasks equipped respectively.
Fixed Whakapanu Island, Isle of Kin, Abandoned Prison and Treasure Map Fragment world markers to not appear before you've reached the area.
Fixed an issue that could be caused when the bosses in The Cuachic Vault were defeated at the same time as soon as they became damageable.
Fixed a bug where heavy stunning Krutog, Lord of Kin from behind would fail to play a heavy stun animation
Fixed the Nameless Seer not automatically closing his shop after you take a Unique Item from him
Fixed issue where character models could fail to display on the Character Select screen.
Fixed Iron Count saying nothing on sorceress in character creation scene
Fixed issue where couch co-op games were starting with P2 as party leader
Fixed couch co-op bug causing issues with using the Horn of Vastiri.
Fixed couch co-op issue with Caravan not stopping and exit remaining closed
Fixed various client crashes.
Fixed a bug where you couldn't pick up items or interact with objects while mounted on a Rhoa Mount.
Fixed an instance in which you would gain the benefits of Rhoa Mount while you are dismounted.

Fixed a bug where Ambrosia Support and Concoct Support were granting their full benefits when only a portion of their desired flask charge consumption could be fulfilled. Both supports now only consume flask charges if their desired amount can be fully fulfilled.
Fixed an issue where in some cases Explosive Shot would remove Fully Broken Armour from enemies.
Fixed a bug where fire infusion stats were not applying to Ice and Lightning Bolts of Firestorm.

Fixed several bugs allowing stats affecting charge gain to effectively double dip. Chances to gain additional charges now only rolls before effects that change the type of change gained (such as Resonance keystone) - previously could roll twice, once before and once after. Similarly, both the above effects are only checked before effects that cause other things to gain your charges for you (such as Conduit keystone). This means only the original charge generator's stats affect the type and number of charges they give out in this way.
Fixed a bug where Vaulting Impact and Thunderous Leap could not be animation cancelled.
